# Hologram Index

> Self-verifying addresses for open model weights on Hugging Face. Static JSON, no account, no key,
> served by GitHub Pages and jsDelivr. Fetch a model's document, download files from their normal
> URLs, hash what you received, compare. Anything that does not match is not the file that was published.

Hosts (identical bytes, use any; every manifest is named by its own hash, so no host needs trusting):
- https://humuhumu33.github.io/hologram-index/
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/humuhumu33/hologram-index@main/

## Verify a model in three commands

```
curl -s https://humuhumu33.github.io/hologram-index/v1/huggingface.co/<owner>/<repo>/latest.json -o weights.lock
curl -sL "$(python3 -c 'import json;print([f["url"] for f in json.load(open("weights.lock"))["files"] if f["path"]=="model.safetensors"][0])')" -o model.safetensors
sha256sum model.safetensors   # must equal the hex after "sha256:" for that file in weights.lock
```

`weights.lock` is also a pin file: `HOLO_VERIFY_PIN=weights.lock` (holo-verify) and
`hologram-api audit <dir> --pin weights.lock` read it directly.

## Documents

- [v1/huggingface.co/<owner>/<repo>/latest.json](https://humuhumu33.github.io/hologram-index/v1/huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/latest.json): newest indexed commit. Fields: name, revision, manifest, files[] {path, size, address, url, weights?, hub_etag?}.
- v1/huggingface.co/<owner>/<repo>/<commit>.json: the same for a pinned commit. Immutable.
- v1/manifests/<hex>.json: canonical manifest bytes; blake3 of the file must equal <hex>.
- [v1/index.json](https://humuhumu33.github.io/hologram-index/v1/index.json): every indexed model with revision and manifest, plus repos skipped and why.
- [capabilities.json](https://humuhumu33.github.io/hologram-index/capabilities.json): this, machine-readable.

## Addresses

- `sha256:<64 hex>` — SHA-256 of the file's bytes. Every file in the index carries one.
- `gitsha1:<40 hex>` — the Hub's own Git blob hash, given as `hub_etag` for small files.
- `blake3:<64 hex>` — the manifest's address.

## Coverage and freshness

Top models on Hugging Face by downloads, public and ungated, refreshed daily. Gated models are not
indexed yet. `latest.json` can trail a repo by up to a day plus CDN caching (jsDelivr branch URLs: 12 h);
a `<commit>.json` never changes. For a model that is not listed, the Hub's own
`/api/models/<repo>/revision/<rev>?blobs=true` gives the SHA-256 of its weight files.
